title: Backend & Data: API query + types + mapper for schedule instructors + duration dict
content:
Completed changes:
1. API route GET /api/courses/[slug] — added instructors include inside schedules Prisma query
2. types.ts — added instructor: { name, title, bio } to ScheduleSession type
3. map-course-detail.ts — updated ApiSchedule interface + mapping for schedule instructors (locale-aware name/title/bio)
4. map-course-detail.ts — added extractDurationNumber() helper to strip unit ("1.5 Hours" → "1.5"), applied to syllabus + schedule mappings
5. Dictionaries — added labels.durationUnit ("hours" / "小時" / "学时")
6. Schema NOT changed (durationZh/durationEn reverted per user request)

findings: typecheck: 0 errors from changed files (2 pre-existing CourseCard errors)
evidence.residual: Schema unchanged: duration remains single string field, locale handled by dict

comments.name: opencode
comments.text: Initial schema migration for durationZh/durationEn was reverted per user request. Duration unit handled via dictionary keys instead.

acceptance: API GET /api/courses/[slug] returns schedule with instructors[] containing id, nameZh, nameEn, titleZh, titleEn, bioZh, bioEn, avatarUrl
ScheduleSession type has optional instructor: { name, title, bio }
mapApiCourseDetail extracts numeric duration (strips units), maps first schedule instructor locale-aware
Dictionaries have durationUnit key in all 3 locales
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: 1) npm run typecheck && npm run lint 2) Inspect API response at /api/courses/CPD26090103?locale=en to verify schedules include instructors
